content.name: Pranav Shinde
content.title: Assistant Project Manager
content.summary: Assistant project manager at a Pune infrastructure contractor, with a B.E. in Civil Engineering from COEP and a year as a graduate trainee at an auto components plant expansion. CAPM-certified and comfortable with Primavera P6, MS Project and site billing. Helped bring a warehouse project in 3 weeks ahead of its handover date.

experience.title: Assistant Project Manager
bullets: Support the project manager on a ₹48 crore warehousing park, updating the Primavera P6 schedule and running daily progress meetings.
Helped hand over the first 2 lakh sq ft warehouse 3 weeks early by re-sequencing roofing and flooring crews.
Verify subcontractor RA bills against measurements, catching ₹11 lakh in over-billing in the first year.
Maintain the site safety and quality checklists for a workforce of about 150.

experience.title: Graduate Engineer Trainee, Projects
bullets: Tracked civil and utility works for a new machining shop, reporting weekly to the plant projects head.
Coordinated equipment foundation drawings with three vendors, avoiding rework on 12 machine bases.
Prepared material reconciliation statements for cement and steel.

education.school: College of Engineering Pune (COEP Technological University)
education.details: CGPA 8.3/10. Final-year project: planning a low-cost housing cluster using Primavera P6.

achievements.title: Best site trainee
achievements.detail: Named best graduate trainee in the Chakan Auto Components projects department (2024).

achievements.title: Concrete canoe competition
achievements.detail: Led the college team's concrete canoe build at an inter-college civil engineering fest (2022).
